description: We provide pro-bono support for non-profit organizations through developing advanced analytical insights to recognize uplifting initiatives around the globe. By using ‘tech for social good’, our diverse team of talented individuals pride on the impact they make working on meaningful projects in the societal, healthcare, and environmental domain. We focus our efforts in not only providing effective solutions to real world issues, but also in addressing ethical challenges within the tech landscape. This has become increasingly evident with the rapid advancement of technology along with the prevalence of data in today’s world. In our committee, we strive to instill a passion for ethical commitment within our members as they prepare to pursue their professional endeavors.
